applies_to: Lenze i510 cabinet inverters 0.25-2.2 kW with the Modbus/CANopen control unit, selector set to Modbus, firmware 01.01.01.00 as documented in the commissioning manual.
summary: Lenze's i510 is a compact cabinet frequency inverter whose Modbus/CANopen control unit acts as a Modbus RTU slave. Besides 24 freely mappable registers, it has fixed blocks: status data from 42001 and control data from 42101. This map covers those predefined registers: AC drive control and status words, frequency setpoint and actual frequency, drive status, error code, motor voltage and current, apparent power, temperatures, DC bus and torque.

addressing.note: The manual states all data are 4X registers numbered from 1 but addressed from 0, so register 40001 is address 0; its example writes register 42101 to address 2100 (0x0834). So 42001 = wire 2000 and 42101 = wire 2100.

source.title: Inverter i510 Cabinet 0.25 ... 2.2 kW - Configuration | Commissioning | Service
source.pages: pp. 105-110 (AC drive control/status word, drive status, setpoint and actual frequency), pp. 127-137 (Modbus chapter: settings, function codes and addressing p. 131, predefined registers p. 132, short setup and example frame p. 137), pp. 229-250 (parameter attribute list: data type and factor)

notes: This copy is hosted by the US distributor Precision Electric and is the unaltered Lenze commissioning manual; Lenze's own copy sits in its download portal and was not found as a direct public link.
Data types and scaling come from the parameter attribute list (data type and network factor: the integer read is divided by the factor, e.g. factor 10 -> scale 0.1).
Apparent power 42008/42009 is a 32-bit signed value; the register table states 42008 = high word and 42009 = low word (ABCD), factor 1000 (kW as printed).

Left out: 42012 digital inputs (0x60FD is a 32-bit parameter but only one register is assigned, so which half is sent is unclear); 42103 and 42104, because the register table gives 42103 as NETWordIN2 with address 0x4008:003 (which the attribute list calls NETWordIN3) and repeats 0x400B:001 for 42104.
The 24 freely mappable registers (0x232B:1-24, internal register numbers from 2500 shown in 0x232C) are not listed; their content depends on configuration.
Only function codes 3, 6, 16 and 23 are supported; all data are holding registers. Data are big-endian (most significant byte first).

registers.name: Actual frequency (0x400C:006)
registers.description: Unsigned; direction is in the status word.

registers.name: Network setpoint frequency (0x400B:005)
registers.description: Unsigned, 0.00-599.00 Hz; direction via control word.

integration.summary: Set the front selector to Modbus, activate the network (0x2631:037 = TRUE) and make the network the setpoint source (0x2860:001 = 5). Write 0x0061 to 42101 (run forward + control and reference from network) and the frequency to 42102 in 0.01 Hz; read 42001-42011 for status and measurements.
integration.enable: Set the Modbus/CANopen selector on the inverter front to Modbus. Set 0x2631:037 (PAR 400/037) Activate network = TRUE and 0x2860:001 (PAR 201/001) = 5 Network. Set node address 0x2321:001 (1-247, default 1), baud 0x2321:002 and data format 0x2321:003 (both default Automatic), then restart Modbus communication (0x2320 = 1) or power-cycle.
integration.watchdog: 0x2858:002 Time-out (0.0-300.0 s, default 2.0 s) with 0x2858:001 Response to time-out (default Error).
quirks: The frequency setpoint and actual frequency are unsigned; direction comes from control word bits 0/1 and status bits 2/3.
With automatic baud rate or data format detection the first 5-10 messages after power-up are lost.
Digital input DI1 is 'Start enable' by default and must be high for the drive to start.
setup: Baud 2400-115200 or automatic; data format 8E1, 8O1, 8N2 or automatic.
A minimum response delay can be set in 0x2321:004 (0-1000 ms).
gotchas: The manual's example: writing 0x0061 to 42101 on node 1 starts the drive if DI1 is high.
MOD-ERR LED blinking = communication error; MOD-RUN and MOD-ERR flickering = automatic baud detection still running.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
